pairedBearer.description: Bearer issued by claim or rotate.

info.description: Any route may answer 503 with an empty body when the 15 second handler time budget, which includes the wait for one of the 32 in-flight request slots, expires. Treat an empty 503 as a transient outage, except on the claim route, which is never retried automatically: the invitation is single use and the claim may already have consumed it. Any route answers 403 with an empty body and Cache-Control: no-store to a request whose Origin header the Hub does not admit (neither its own origin nor one of the owner's allowed origins) or that names a route without browser access. Which routes admit browser origins, and how the Hub answers a CORS preflight (an OPTIONS request), are set by the Hub and lie outside this profile; a client that sends no Origin header never sees any of them.
info.title: Teslatlas Hub public HTTP profile hub-http-v1

post.description: Revoke the calling device. The request has no body; any non-empty body, including one over 4096 bytes, is 400 and revokes nothing (never 413).

400.description: Request extraction or validation failed; body is bounded text/plain.

401.description: The invitation secret is invalid, expired or already claimed; empty body.

413.description: The request body, of a JSON media type (application/json or application/*+json), is over the 4096 byte limit and the claim is not attempted; body is bounded text/plain.

415.description: The Content-Type is missing or is not a JSON media type (application/json or application/*+json), whatever the size of the body; body is bounded text/plain.

422.description: The body is valid JSON but not a claim request, or its device_name is one the Hub refuses (empty, over 128 UTF-8 bytes or with a control character); the claim is not attempted and the invitation is not consumed; body is bounded text/plain.

503.description: Service unavailable; empty body (also the answer when the handler time budget expires). Never retry a claim automatically: the invitation is single use and the claim may already have consumed it.
